"""Offline test-only derivative; only its explicit KVH2 wrapper is exercised."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import sys

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
source = root / "src/cuda/attention/decode_sm120.cu"
destination = Path(sys.argv[1])
text = source.read_text()
before = "constexpr int kDecodeGlobalGqaTileTokens = 16;"
assert text.count(before) == 1
text = text.replace(before, "constexpr int kDecodeGlobalGqaTileTokens = 32;")
text += r'''
// Diagnostic entry point only. Other emitted functions are not exercised.
extern "C" cudaError_t gem16_lab_launch_kvh2_stage32(
    const float* query, const std::uint8_t* keys, const std::uint8_t* values,
    const std::uint16_t* key_scale, const std::uint16_t* value_scale,
    float* partial, float* lse, float* output,
    const gem16::internal::DecodeControl* control, int splits,
    dim3 grid, dim3 block, cudaStream_t stream) {
  using namespace gem16::internal;
  SplitOnlineDecodeAttentionFp8GlobalKvh2Kernel<false><<<grid, block, 0U, stream>>>(
      query, keys, values, key_scale, value_scale, partial, lse, output,
      control, 0U, nullptr, splits);
  return cudaGetLastError();
}
'''
assert not destination.exists()
destination.write_text(text)
destination.with_suffix(".provenance.json").write_text(json.dumps({
    "diagnostic_only": True,
    "source": str(source),
    "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "transform": "16 to 32 staging constant in a standalone derivative; exercise only the explicit ordinary KVH2 wrapper",
    "output_sha256": hashlib.sha256(destination.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "production_source_modified": False,
}, indent=2) + "\n")

limitations: Cross-format/model replay controls histories and positions, not model activations or router IDs; no cross-engine quality equivalence.
Diagnostic forward/selection ns have different host readback/oracle paths and are not primary tok/s comparisons.
Operator snapshots reserve 36 MiB; attention adds 25 MiB and borrows historical global KV after an append-only ordinary replay. No model weight copy, repack or offload.
Four representative MoE layers and three positions are captured, not real-input hardware counters for every layer of the whole run.
Warm-resident operator graph timings and cold-cache NCU replay are distinct diagnostics; neither is whole-model DRAM traffic or end-to-end proof. NCU uses its default clock controls.
Stall ratios keep native units; they are not bounded percentages of total time.

NCU stdout interleaves its progress with long application JSON; numerical parity is established in separate unprofiled full replays and explicit byte-exact operator replay, not by decoding the interleaved profiler stream.
Setup failures (C API full-SWA default OOM, verifier/Assistant setup order, copied execute bit, CUDA 13 launch-hook entry point) are retained and excluded from passed gates.
Final reader uses a bounded fixed-size read and rejects short/growing/nonregular input; final host CTest is required separately from earlier GPU driver qualification.
Linux diagnostics only, no new Windows or release qualification.

from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,os,hashlib,subprocess
OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

import audit_run as a
a.OUT=OUT
AUDIT=json.loads((a.ROOT/'artifacts/trellis35/decode-cost-audit-2026-10-22.json').read_text())
for name,key in [('native','gem16-ordinary'),('llama','llama-ordinary')]:
 p=OUT/(name+'-history.ids');expected=','.join(map(str,AUDIT['primary_cohorts'][key]['output_token_ids']))+'\n'
 if p.exists():assert p.read_text()==expected
 else:p.write_text(expected)
prompt=str(OUT.parent/'decode-cost-audit/prompt.ids')
llama_model=AUDIT['gguf_identities']['gguf']['path']
native=str(a.BIN/'gem16-26b-decode-replay-driver');llama=str(OUT/'llama-decode-replay-driver-v2')
a.record('host-replay-parser',['ctest','--test-dir',str(a.BIN.parent),'--output-on-failure','-R','^gem16-unit$'],180)
observed={}
def run(name,engine,history,mode='ordinary',lab=False,candidate=None):
 if engine=='llama':name+='-v2'
 args=[native if engine=='native' else llama,a.PATHS['target'] if engine=='native' else llama_model,prompt,str(OUT/(history+'-history.ids')),mode]
 if engine=='native' and mode!='ordinary':args.append(a.PATHS['assistant'])
 env=os.environ.copy();settings={'GEM16_LLAMA_BACKEND_DIR':str(a.ROOT/'build/Linux/llama_cpp/current-release/bin')}
 if mode!='ordinary':settings['GEM16_VISION_D2_DIAGNOSTIC']='1'
 if lab:
  settings.update(LD_PRELOAD=str(OUT/'trellis35_operator_lab.so'),GEM16_TRELLIS35_OPERATOR_LAB='1',GEM16_LAB_MODE='m1' if mode=='ordinary' else 't3',GEM16_LAB_OUTPUT=str(OUT/(name+'-operators')))
 if candidate:settings['GEM16_LAB_CANDIDATE']=candidate
 env.update(settings);(OUT/(name+'.environment.json')).write_text(json.dumps(settings,indent=2)+'\n')
 p=a.record(name,args,600,env);data=json.loads(p.read_text());observed[name]=data
 if mode=='ordinary':
  assert len(data['rows'])==1134
  ids=AUDIT['primary_cohorts']['gem16-ordinary' if history=='native' else 'llama-ordinary']['output_token_ids']
  assert [r['forced_token'] for r in data['rows']]==ids[:-1]
  assert [r['context_position'] for r in data['rows']]==list(range(16384,17518))
  if engine==history:assert [r['masked_prediction'] for r in data['rows']]==ids[1:],name
 print('VALID',name,flush=True)
 return data
for history in ['native','llama']:
 for engine in ['native','llama']:run(engine+'-'+history+'-history',engine,history)
for engine in ['native','llama']:run(engine+'-forced-d2',engine,'native','d2')
for engine in ['native','llama']:run(engine+'-forced-d2-windows',engine,'native','d2-windows')
data=run('native-m1-capture','native','native',lab=True)
assert data['rows']==observed['native-native-history']['rows'] or [r['masked_prediction'] for r in data['rows']]==[r['masked_prediction'] for r in observed['native-native-history']['rows']]
run('native-t3-capture','native','native','d2-windows',lab=True)
for name in ['native-m1-capture','native-t3-capture']:
 d=json.loads((OUT/(name+'-operators/captures.json')).read_text());assert len(d['cases'])==24 and all(r['projection_bit_exact'] for r in d['cases'])
 assert all(r['k3']+r['k4']==r['assignments'] for r in d['cases'])

from replay_common import *
import csv
for mode in ['m1','t3']:
 for role in ['gate','down']:
  name='ncu-real-'+mode+'-'+role
  command=['ncu','--profile-from-start','off','--kernel-name-base','demangled','--launch-count','1','--cache-control','all']
  for section in ['LaunchStats','Occupancy','SchedulerStats','MemoryWorkloadAnalysis','SpeedOfLight','InstructionStats','WarpStateStats','ComputeWorkloadAnalysis']:command+=['--section',section]
  command+=['--kernel-name','regex:.*MmaW4A8Projection'+('Selected' if mode=='m1' else 'GroupedT3M16')+'N128InverseKernel.*','-o',str(OUT/name),native,a.PATHS['target'],prompt,str(OUT/'native-history.ids'),'ordinary' if mode=='m1' else 'd2-windows']
  if mode=='t3':command.append(a.PATHS['assistant'])
  settings={'LD_PRELOAD':str(OUT/'trellis35_operator_lab-v2.so'),'GEM16_TRELLIS35_OPERATOR_LAB':'1','GEM16_LAB_MODE':mode,'GEM16_LAB_OUTPUT':str(OUT/(name+'-captures')),'GEM16_LAB_PROFILE_CASE':'phase0-layer0-'+role,'GEM16_LAB_PROFILE_KIND':'parent'}
  if mode=='t3':settings['GEM16_VISION_D2_DIAGNOSTIC']='1'
  env=os.environ.copy();env.update(settings);(OUT/(name+'.environment.json')).write_text(json.dumps(settings,indent=2)+'\n')
  a.record(name,command,600,env)
  reports=list(OUT.glob(name+'.ncu-rep*'));assert len(reports)==1,reports
  p=a.record(name+'-raw',['ncu','--import',str(reports[0]),'--csv','--page','raw'],180)
  rows=list(csv.DictReader(p.open()));assert len(rows)==2,(name,len(rows))
  metrics={k:{'value':rows[1][k],'unit':rows[0][k]} for k in rows[1] if k.startswith(('launch__registers','derived__local_spilling','sm__warps_active','smsp__issue_active','smsp__warps_eligible','dram__throughput','lts__t_sector','smsp__average_warps_issue_stalled','sm__pipe_tensor'))}
  (OUT/(name+'-metrics.json')).write_text(json.dumps(metrics,indent=2)+'\n')
  print('REAL RESOURCE PROFILE COMPLETE',name,flush=True)
print('ALL FOUR REAL-INPUT RESOURCE PROFILES COMPLETE',flush=True)
